paper_title: SRPO Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware   Reinforcement Learning
caption_used: Accuracy comparison of six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. Each benchmark displays grouped bars for DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). In Mathverse, SRPO achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56%, while DAPO+Self-reflection follows at roughly 55%, with the remaining methods clustered between 53% and 54%. Across MMLU, GRPO leads with approximately 57%, narrowly exceeding DAPO+Self-reflection, and PPO trails at about 54.5%. In the Physics benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches roughly 61%, with SRPO close behind at 60.5% and PPO at the lowest with approximately 57%. Notably, the self-reflection variants do not consistently outperform their base counterparts, as GRPO surpasses PPO+Self-reflection in both Mathverse and MMLU.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Степента на точност е представена от стълбовидна диаграма, която показва сравнението на точността на шест конфигурации на обучение с подсилване върху три набора от данни: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите на бенчмарка, подредени по азбучен ред: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Вертикалната ос показва процента на точността, измерван в диапазона от 53% до 62%, етикетиран с интервали от 2%. Скалата е линеарна и използва процентни точки като числа. Най-ниската стълба, Mathverse, показва точност от приблизително 53%, докато най-високата, Mathverse, показва 62%. В Mathverse SRPO достига най-високата точност, приблизително 56%, последвана от DAPO+Self-reflection приблизително 55%, а останалите методи са групирани между 53% и 54%. В MMLU GRPO отива на първо място с приблизително 57%, надминавайки DAPO+Self-reflection, с PPO, който се задържа с около 54,5%. В бенчмарка Physics DAPO+Self-reflection достига приблизително 61%, с SRPO непосредствено след него с 60,5% и PPO с най-ниската стойност, приблизително 57%. Всяка стълба представлява конкретна конфигурация на обучението с подсилване, така че например стълбата с площ в синьо показва DAPO+Self-reflection, а стълбата с площ в оранжево показва GRPO. Някои от стълбите са визуално подчертани чрез засенчване, за да се демонстрира отделния компонент.
model_annotations.Chinese: 图表展示了六种强化学习配置在三个基准测试中的准确率比较。水平轴表示基准测试，包括“Mathverse”、“MMLU”和“Physics”三个标签。垂直轴表示准确率，单位为百分比，刻度从53%到62%不等，刻度间隔为1%。值轴从53%到62%之间均匀间隔。图表包含六个柱状图，分别代表“DAPO+Self-reflection”（蓝色实线柱状图）、“DAPO”（蓝色虚线柱状图）、“SRPO”（橙色实线柱状图）、“GRPO”（橙色虚线柱状图）、“PPO+Self-reflection”（绿色实线柱状图）和“PPO”（绿色虚线柱状图）。在“Mathverse”基准测试中，SRPO的柱状图的长度约为56%，DAPO+Self-reflection的柱状图的长度约为55%，其余配置的柱状图长度在53%到54%之间。在“MMLU”基准测试中，GRPO的柱状图的长度约为57%，DAPO+Self-reflection的柱状图的长度约为54.5%，PPO的柱状图的长度约为54%。在“Physics”基准测试中，DAPO+Self-reflection的柱状图的长度约为61%，SRPO的柱状图的长度约为60.5%，PPO的柱状图的长度约为57%。所有柱状图均按时长由短到长排列。
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates a comparison of accuracy rates for six distinct reinforcement learning configurations – DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO – across three different benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis represents the benchmarks, arranged in order from left to right as Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis displays accuracy rates, expressed as percentages, and ranges from approximately 53% to 62%. The scale is linear, with tick labels spaced approximately every 2 percentage points. The bars vary in color, with DAPO+Self-reflection represented by solid blue bars, DAPO by hatched blue bars, SRPO by solid orange bars, GRPO by hatched orange bars, PPO+Self-reflection by solid green bars, and PPO by hatched green bars. In Mathverse, the SRPO bar reaches approximately 56%, the DAPO+Self-reflection bar reaches 55%, and the remaining configurations are clustered between 53% and 54%. For MMLU, the GRPO bar is approximately 57%, DAPO+Self-reflection is approximately 56%, and PPO is approximately 54.5%. Within the Physics benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches approximately 61%, SRPO is approximately 60.5%, and PPO is approximately 57%. The bars are not sorted in any particular order; however, the SRPO and DAPO+Self-reflection bars are visually emphasized through their color and position within the chart relative to the other configurations.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm vergleicht die Genauigkeit verschiedener Stärkungslernkonfigurationen über drei Benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU und Physik. Die horizontale Achse stellt die Benchmarks dar, während die vertikale Achse die Genauigkeit in Prozent anzeigt, wobei die Skala von etwa 53% bis 62% reicht. Der Diagrammgegenstand besteht aus sechs gruppierten Balken, die jeweils eine andere Konfiguration darstellen: DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection und PPO. Der blau gefärbte Balken für DAPO+Self-reflection erreicht etwa 56 %, der grau gefärbte Balken für DAPO erreicht etwa 54 %, der orange gefärbte Balken für SRPO erreicht etwa 60 %, der hellorange gefärbte Balken für GRPO erreicht etwa 57 %, der grüne Balken für PPO+Self-reflection erreicht etwa 55 % und der hellgrüne Balken für PPO erreicht etwa 57 %. In Mathverse erreicht SRPO die höchste Genauigkeit (56 %), gefolgt von DAPO+Self-reflection (55 %), während die verbleibenden Methoden zwischen 53 % und 54 % liegen. Für MMLU liegt GRPO mit etwa 57 % an der Spitze, übertrifft DAPO+Self-reflection und verhält sich bei etwa 54,5 % für PPO. In Physik erreicht DAPO+Self-reflection etwa 61 %, SRPO großzügig hinterher mit 60,5 % und PPO am niedrigsten mit etwa 57 %.
